title: Watch Face AAPSv2 Missing IOB and 10min BG Delta

comments.body: @erobinson is this still happening?  I think it should be temporary. Not all data is available at the start of your watch app. Therefore the data will be updated with 3 different data sets.
It's been like that for a few weeks, haven't done any debugging/testing to isolate the problem.
Found that I didn't have the show delta & show IOB settings turned on 😢 All working fine.
